CC-F-020 Ed. 08-24 Additional Limits Endorsement Specific Client, 
Contract, Project, or Service
Adds a separate limit for work for a specific client, 
contract, project, or service. 
•  AP-C-001 Accountants

Liability Coverage

the request of the insured and at the 
agreement of Travelers to add a 
separate limit for work performed for 
a specific client, contract, project, or 
services.

Broadens Yes This endorsement will be attached at 
the request of the insured and at the

defense limits should not erode limit
